column1: # Frozen settings for the C4 development-donor LEAVE-ONE-OUT campaign. Committed before any donor of
# this campaign is run, and bound into every run's signature.
# TWO LINEAGES MEET HERE, and both are recorded rather than collapsed into one number:
#   READS come from the ordinary-LZO lineage (tests/genotype_coverage_settings.tsv): seed 20260916,
#   UNSALTED. That is the stream the eight frozen development sources under
#   tests/results/genotype_coverage_c4_development_2c32c89 were drawn from. Regeneration under the
#   current probe is byte-identical to those sources -- verified for NA19240, uncompressed content
#   d2cff2441f02fc40743f35c8a3ece8ea5fead05fd025d1effdd8626b23adb937 -- so the donor PRESENT in the
#   panel and the same donor REMOVED from it are compared on identical input. That paired comparison
#   is the whole reason for reusing this seed rather than the grouped-prefix one.
#   CALLER SETTINGS come from the grouped-prefix lineage
#   (tests/genotype_c4_heldout_mosaic_manifest.tsv): proposal width 256, arms K=0 and K=128, phase
# The round-7 combination -- proposal width 1024, mosaic K 8, phase audit 256 -- is REJECTED by name
# in the manifest gate. NA19240 reaches the blockwise availability floor only at K=128 (distance 4,
# against 6 for the whole panel at K=0), so a K=8 cohort measures a different question.
# The scorer caps and cache budget below are EXPERIMENTAL overrides for this campaign, passed
# explicitly and bound into provenance. The global defaults are unchanged: 2e9 piece hits, 5e8
